basic_info.description: In the quiet residential area of San Francisco's coveted Mission District, this exceptional 3 bed, 3 bath house-like condo is a rare blend   of timeless craftsmanship, enduring quality, and enviable location. Just blocks from the city's most iconic restaurants San Ho Won,   Flour & Water, and Tartine Manufactury it's a foodie's dream amid an urban sanctuary. Built in 2008 as the personal residence of one   of San Francisco's finest general contractors, every detail was chosen to last. Bathed in natural light and spanning the top two floors of   a two-unit building, this home was designed for both intimate moments and unforgettable gatherings. Take in sweeping vistas from   Bernal Heights, Twin Peaks and Sutro Tower from the West Deck as the city glows at sunset.The bedroom level offers a generous   ensuite primary, and two additional bedrooms individually zoned with radiant heat, a guest bath, laundry, and linen storage. Upstairs,   the chef's kitchen flows into a dining and living space with fireplace and custom built-ins. A den with full bath offers a den/fourth bed or dream home office. Step directly from this level onto nearly 650 square feet of private outdoor space.
